title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is increasing between Merrill Rd and FRH as spot fires ignite and evacuations start; traffic first gridlocks at the Wagstaff Rd intersection.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire exposure to the roadway increases between FRH and Pearson Rd. Traffic volume continues to increase.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire impacts vehicles near Merrill Rd and Chaney Ln. There is heavy traffic between the fire impacted areas. Traffic flow southbound out of Paradise increases.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: There is traffic gridlock throughout Pentz Rd. Heavy traffic evacuates northbound north of Merrill Rd, others are stuck between Wagstaff Rd and FRH. Inbound traffic is blocked by law enforcement.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: The fire front impacts traffic stuck between Bille Rd and FRH (BO #6). Evacuees north of Dean Rd are progressing towards Skyway.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Evacuees are directed to the FRH parking lot to escape from fire conditions between FRH and Bille Rd. Pentz Rd south of FRH remains blocked by fire.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire, power lines, and emergency response block passage south of FRH and north of Bille Rd. Heavy traffic progresses south of Paradise toward CA-70. Northbound traffic is jammed at Pentz Rd and Skyway.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire is subsiding at FRH and some civilians evacuate south. The Bille Rd intersection remains gridlocked in high exposures and is being protected by a fire engine (BO #8).

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Gridlock at the Skyway intersection has cleared.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Vehicles from the Bille Rd intersection are escorted to the Kmart TRA.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: A number of utility lines and utility poles block Pentz Rd north of Wagstaff Rd.

title: Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Pentz Rd through Paradise is navigable.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is getting locally gridlocked in areas near initial spot fires and local evacuations.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is heading SB on Clark Rd south of Wagstaff Rd. Gridlock at Clark Rd and Skyway significantly limits traffic movement at the northern end, affecting vehicles coming from north of Wagstaff Rd or from Pentz Rd.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Arteries feeding Clark Rd from the west are causing local gridlock at major intersections in Paradise. Localized areas in Paradise have contraflow. Clark Rd is flowing southbound out of town.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Contraflow is implemented along Clark Rd between Wagstaff Rd and Pearson Rd for all lanes SB.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Outbound traffic is backed up to the airport (~8 km [~5 mi]) due to slow downs at the Durham- Pentz Rd intersection.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire is burning along Clark Rd at the south end of Paradise, impacting traffic.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Vehicles drive through fire and Clark Rd is subsequently closed in the vicinity of American Way (BO #10). SB traffic is diverted from Clark Rd onto Buschmann Rd. Traffic south of the airport is backed up to Durham-Pentz Rd and occasionally two lanes SB.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire exposures have decreased, allowing for one lane to be re-opened on Clark Rd south of Buschmann Rd. Contraflow of Clark Rd between Durham-Pentz Rd and CA-70 is implemented to alleviate traffic. In Paradise, the backup has cleared north of Bille Rd through Wagstaff Rd.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is continuing to clear on upper Clark Rd, now backed up south of Elliott Rd. Southbound Clark Rd is directed WB onto Pearson Rd and traffic from Pearson Rd is directed SB on Clark Rd to Buschmann Rd. Fifty-foot flames are crossing Clark Rd near Round Valley Ranch Rd.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is held at Clark Rd and Skyway due to fire blocking Skyway south of Clark Rd and north of Pentz Rd. Heavy fire exposures between American Way and Airport Rd close Clark Rd again, preventing civilian evacuations and first responder ingress.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Clark Rd in Paradise is largely free of traffic. A number of civilian vehicles are traveling SB on Clark Rd and sent WB on Pearson Rd. Clark Rd south of Buschmann Rd is still closed due to fire.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: A 1.6 km (1 mi) stretch of Clark Rd is burned over between Cabernet Ln and Wagstaff Rd. There is limited evacuation and first responder activity along this stretch of Clark Rd at this time.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire and power lines continue to impede travel on Clark Rd north of Wagstaff Rd. Fire is also burning across Clark Rd between Pearson Rd and Buschmann Rd. Clark Rd is clear of traffic backups throughout Paradise, except for the closure at the Skyway intersection where civilians have abandoned vehicles in the roadway to seek shelter at the Optimo TRA.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire south of Pearson Rd has subsided enough to barely allow passage. Vehicles in the backup (from westbound) on Pearson Rd are re-directed toward Clark Rd to leave Paradise.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: There are localized blockages of Clark Rd in Paradise due to power lines and fire exposures to the roadway. Several convoys of are led out of town from points south of Pearson Rd.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: Utility pole/line is blocking access for a strike team just north of the airport.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: The southern edge of the fire is south of the airport and the road is closed to northbound traffic.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: The southern edge of the fire is still south of the airport, north of Circle J Rd, and the road remains closed to northbound traffic. Fire is still burning fuels along Clark Rd south of Buschmann Rd, and power lines and other debris obstruct passage in numerous locations.

title: Clark Road traffic progression summary.
text: A strike team headed to Magalia moves cars and trailers by hand to clear a pathway through the gridlock of abandoned vehicles on Clark Rd at Skyway.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Several power lines are down on Skyway in Magalia and Stirling City, likely due to high winds.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: The first major spot fire affects Skyway between Lofty Ln and Clark Rd. Traffic is gridlocked at Clark Rd and some vehicles utilize the bike path to head south. Other intersections see increased traffic.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: The traffic light at Neal Rd is manually programmed to hold a green light for Skyway due to increased traffic. Exact volume/speed of traffic is unclear due to conflicting TD statements.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Fire continues to impact traffic between Lofty Ln and Clark Rd. Law enforcement stops traffic. Skyway becomes very congested north of Pearson Rd. South of Pearson Rd, traffic is flowing out of town with assistance of public works and law enforcement.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement is directing traffic through the spot fire, alternating traffic from Clark Rd and Skyway. Skyway through Paradise is backed up. Additionally, traffic is backed up at the bottom of the hill into Chico, at least as far as Honey Run Rd. NB Skyway is blocked by LE at Bruce Rd.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Fire has expanded between Wagstaff Rd and Clark Rd resulting in two localized burnovers that intermittently permit some evacuation traffic (BO #4).

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: The roadway is again blocked by fire at Lofty Ln, and partially blocked by fire at Quail Way. There is extensive gridlock between Wagstaff Rd and Pearson Rd. Contraflow is implemented, however it is difficult to maintain in some sections.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: A spot fire burns across Skyway between Pentz Rd and Coutolenc Rd, closing the road in both directions. Fire and traffic problems continue in Paradise.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Contraflow is implemented out of Paradise. At least one of the NB lanes is being used by SB traffic.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Heavy fire activity impacts Skyway at the lane divide during peak evacuation. Fire is burning structures on both sides of the road. All lanes are being used for SB traffic.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: All traffic is held at Clark Rd and Skyway due to fire conditions between Wagstaff Rd and Clark Rd; people stuck in this area are abandoning vehicles and fleeing on foot.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic stuck at Pentz Rd is brought to the Optimo TRA at Clark Rd. Traffic continues to be stopped in fire between Wagstaff and Coldren Rd. Traffic is flowing more freely down both sides of Skyway south of the lane divide, although it is still slowed by fire and downed power lines/poles.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Civilians and law enforcement are still stuck in fire in the area of Coldren Rd. Downed power lines and poles near the lane divide are impeding traffic, forcing all traffic SB down the NB lanes.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Skyway is still impassable at Clark Rd due to gridlock, abandoned vehicles, and downed power lines. Traffic is still very heavy and slow through Paradise.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: The intersection at Wagstaff Rd is being impacted by fire; civilians are abandoning vehicles and fleeing on foot. Traffic is beginning to clear out at Bille Rd.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: There are multiple road blocks in Magalia preventing SB traffic into Paradise. People stuck in the area of Rocky Ln are cleared out. Wagstaff Rd is still impacted by fire. Skyway at Bille Rd now has no traffic.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Civilians are rescued from a bus stuck off the road north of Wagstaff Rd as fire burns around the area. There are dozens of abandoned vehicles in the roadway north of Wagstaff Rd.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: A downed utility pole and tree are blocking 3/4 of SB lanes at the lane divide, all but stopping the traffic flow.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Engines are able to barely pass through Skyway from Wagstaff Rd to Clark Rd. There are dozens of abandoned and burning vehicles and fire along the way. All civilians are clear of this area and traffic is not permitted.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is clearing out through Paradise. Most traffic is now south of Pearson Rd and is slowed by the downed power lines near the lane divide.

title: Skyway traffic progression summary.
text: Skyway between Wagstaff Rd and Clark Rd remains closed due to abandoned vehicles and fire. It will not reopen for civilian traffic. Traffic through Paradise is limited to straggling evacuations. Traffic control continues at the lane divide due to the downed tree and power lines; vehicles are sent SB in the NB lanes.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: Pearson Rd west of Clark Rd now has heavy traffic volume as evacuating vehicles are directed toward Skyway from Clark Rd.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: A dozer leads civilian vehicles from the Pearson TRA to FRH around burned, abandoned vehicles and power lines.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: There are over 40 abandoned and burned vehicles between Hilbe Dr and Sawmill Rd. A dozer clears vehicles off the roadway. Pearson Rd has very heavy traffic west of Sawmill Rd. Dispatchers at PPD evacuate.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: A line of 120 vehicles is backed up east of Clark Rd to Newland Rd. There is no traffic east of Newland Rd.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: The roadway is blocked between Newland Rd and Middle Libby Rd; a dozen civilian vehicles attempting to evacuate turn around and wait at Fire Station 82.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: Abandoned vehicles and downed power lines continue to obstruct the eastern section of Pearson Rd as first responders travel through. All traffic from Clark Rd is being directed west over to Skyway; there is no traffic on Pearson Rd east of Clark Rd.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: Downed power lines are a recurring issue east of Clark Rd requiring multiple actions by first responders to keep the roadway passable. The intersection at Clark Rd is now clear of traffic.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: Conditions deteriorate dramatically east of Clark Rd toward Newland Rd. Everything is on fire making this portion of Pearson Rd closed to all civilian vehicles. A fire engine barely makes passage through flames, debris, and zero visibility.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic has cleared from Pearson Rd as the final civilians evacuate down Skyway.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: A small group of 3 to 6 civilian vehicles are waiting for the road to be cleared. An engine clears power lines and poles in the vicinity of Cherry Ln. Similar incidents occur throughout the afternoon in this area.

title: Pearson Road traffic progression summary.
text: Pearson Rd is impassable due to major fire exposures between Academy Dr and Foster Rd. No civilians were present at this time, although first responder safety and movements were impacted.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire activity is increasing rapidly along Pentz Rd, restricting egress (north at Merrill Rd and south of FRH). Civilians evacuating from Pentz Rd begin to converge on both Bille Rd and Wagstaff Rd.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is very heavy on Bille Rd as both lanes are contraflow westbound from Pentz Rd to Skyway.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Evacuating vehicles are forming 3 lanes westbound east of Sawmill Rd attempting to flee the fire on Pentz Rd. The roadway has 2 marked lanes. Traffic is moving very slowly.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is moving no more than 2 mi/h between Pentz Rd and Clark Rd. Multiple law enforcement officers are attempting to get traffic flowing.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Heavy ember cast is impacting the area as fire closes in. People are abandoning vehicles in stopped traffic at the east end of Bille Rd in the vicinity of Tyden Way, further restricting traffic flow.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire is in the immediate area of the Pentz Rd intersection. Additional vehicles arrive intermittently as they make their way through fire on Pentz Rd. An engine arrives and hooks to the hydrant; fire fighters use the deck gun to spray and protect between 70 and 100 vehicles within reach.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: People are evacuated from their vehicles as fire impacts the traffic jam at Tyden Way beyond the reach of the deck gun. Fire and abandoned vehicles block the roadway.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is backed up on the west side of Skyway as civilians try to egress down Skyway. (Note, this is the first data point in this area, however, traffic here has very likely been backed up for a long time).

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: The intersection at Clark Rd is cleared and the traffic backup has converged toward Skyway.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire exposures subside, however, vehicles are still held at the Bille Rd TRA because of the blocked roadways and nowhere to egress.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Due to congestion and fire issues at the Skyway intersection, vehicles on Bille Rd east of Skyway are turned around and directed back to Clark Rd. Civilians stuck on Skyway are being directed to walk to the Walgreens TRA.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Vehicles from the Bille Rd / Pentz Rd intersection are escorted to the Kmart TRA.

title: Bille Road traffic progression summary.
text: Bille Rd near Tyden Way remains impassable due to burning vehicles into the afternoon. AVL indicates first responders are able to drive through by 16:00, and a dozer consolidates burned vehicles around 20:00. One lane is blocked for several days after the fire.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is quickly increasing from Pentz Rd.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is now very heavy east of Clark Rd. Due to heavy traffic on Clark Rd, vehicles on Wagstaff Rd cannot progress further west. Traffic turning west from Clark Rd and traffic originating east of Clark Rd is increasing.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic from Pentz Rd is using both lanes westbound to escape the fire. Traffic conditions are locally variable, and traffic west of Clark Rd is in both directions.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire impacts the Pentz Rd intersection where traffic is gridlocked. Traffic is backed up in both directions between Skyway and Clark Rd as people try to access both egress routes.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Conditions deteriorate locally along Wagstaff Rd between Clark Rd and Skyway. An engine is protecting a line of vehicles as structures and vegetation burn along the roadway. Vehicles are directed to the Kmart parking lot TRA.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic at Clark Rd is reducing. Fire is still burning between Skyway and Clark Rd, however, most civilians have been evacuated from the area and there is no stopped traffic in the fire.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Wagstaff Rd between Clark Rd and Skyway is clear of traffic. Conditions are locally smoky, and some fire activity remains. The intersection at Skyway is backed up with traffic on Skyway, however, there are few or no vehicles merging from Wagstaff Rd.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Convoy of approximately 70 vehicles directed from Skyway to the Kmart TRA via Rocky Ln and Wagstaff Rd.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: Convoy of approximately 50 vehicles directed from Bille Rd TRA on Pentz Rd to the Kmart TRA via Wagstaff Rd.

title: Wagstaff Road traffic progression summary.
text: No substantial traffic occurs on Wagstaff Rd through the afternoon. There are instances of downed power lines and debris in the roadways. Civilians are advised to stay in the safety of the Kmart parking lot TRA.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic backs up on Elliott Rd at Clark Rd. Traffic conditions may have backed up as early as 08:00. Law enforcement is present directing traffic by 08:00.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement is guiding traffic at Elliott Rd and Skyway; 5 lanes SB Skyway plus 2 lanes WB Elliott Rd are squeezed to 3 lanes SB on Skyway just south of Elliott Rd.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic from the eastern section of Elliott Rd is directed to use 2 lanes SB onto Clark Rd and one lane to continue WB toward Skyway; Clark Rd SB is very slow.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is heavy on Elliott Rd between Clark Rd and Skyway, but is moving faster than traffic on Clark Rd. More vehicles are sent over toward Skyway.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: A request is made to clear Elliott Rd east of Clark Rd due to the approaching fire. Traffic is still backed up at Clark Rd and Skyway.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: Elliott Rd is backed up from Skyway to Clark Rd. Traffic is only using the westbound lanes.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: The backup on Elliott Rd has reduced to extend from Skyway to Almond St, now using both lanes. No additional traffic is coming from Clark Rd.

title: Elliott Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic on Elliott Rd is clear by 12:15. Fig. 19. View of traffic back up > 300 m on Elliott Rd looking east from Skyway at 10:57. Traffic is mostly single lane heading west.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: The traffic light at Neal Rd is manually programmed to hold a green light for Skyway due to increased traffic. Exact volume/speed of traffic is unclear due to conflicting TD statements.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement advises that traffic on Neal Rd is currently light and could accommodate traffic diverted from Skyway.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement indicates on the radio that Neal Rd is clear of traffic [specific location unknown].

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement has discussions about whether to keep Neal Rd two-way traffic to allow inbound emergency vehicles or to contraflow using both lanes outbound to expedite evacuations. 9:45       Law enforcement blocks NB traffic on Neal Rd from CA-99 and begins using both lanes of Neal Rd for evacuation.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Neal Rd is seeing increased traffic diverted from Skyway. Traffic is also increasing at the intersection with CA-99. Contraflow is used near the intersection.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is building on Neal Rd within Paradise limits from Skyway and Wayland Rd.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement is sending both lanes southbound at Neal Rd trying to manage very heavy traffic from both Neal Rd and Wayland Rd.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Skyway south of Neal Rd is blocked by fire. Traffic diverting down Neal Rd gridlocks due to the heavy volume and merging from side streets.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: By 11:15, Neal Rd is bumper to bumper in the southbound lane from CA-99 up to the town limits. Within town, traffic is gridlocked with all lanes used for southbound egress.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Heavy, slow and stopped traffic continues on Neal Rd using two lanes for outbound traffic. Traffic is a standstill for the next hour. Incoming first responders struggle to get through the traffic, often driving off the road, averaging 2 mi/h against the flow.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Fire impacts the traffic in the area of Wayland Rd and Neal Rd.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement prevents additional traffic from using Neal Rd from Skyway due to the fire burnover. Traffic is caught in heavy fire which now extends from the area of Roe Rd south through the intersection at Wayland Rd.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Heavy traffic on Neal Rd is moving approximately 10 mi/h to CA-99.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: There is no traffic on Neal Rd at Goa Way, south of the town limits.

title: Neal Road traffic progression summary.
text: Neal Rd is clear of traffic at Wayland Rd. There are still two lanes of traffic backed up from CA-99 for at least 1000 m (0.6 mi).

title: Foster Road and Wayland Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic on Foster Rd is increasing as people seek a way to egress via Neal Rd. Traffic struggles to turn left from Wayland Rd onto Neal Rd and some vehicles at the end of the line return north on Foster Rd.

title: Foster Road and Wayland Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is being diverted from Clark Rd to take Buschmann Rd to Foster Rd for access to Neal Rd and Skyway.

title: Foster Road and Wayland Road traffic progression summary.
text: Within a matter of minutes Wayland Rd jams at Neal Rd and traffic backs up on Foster Rd.

title: Foster Road and Wayland Road traffic progression summary.
text: Foster Rd is backed up from Wayland Rd to Buschmann Rd. Traffic from Buschmann Rd is diverted to fill up Black Olive Dr to avoid entrapments at the tail end of the line on Clark Rd.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: SB CA-99 is congested in Chico north of CA-32. This is likely due to typical morning commute traffic as well as visibility of the large smoke plume.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: CA-99 NB may be closed at or near Durham-Pentz Rd. This data point is unconfirmed with additional information at this time.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is heavy on CA-99 near Neal Rd. First responders are driving down the center median.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: LE is blocking northbound traffic onto Neal Rd at CA-99 to prevent civilian access to the fire area and to allow for emergency vehicle access.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: Emergency vehicles are responding from the north and encounter light traffic through Chico.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is jammed in both directions at Neal Rd. First responders are driving down the median. SB traffic is backed up 3.8 km (2.3 mi) to Estates Dr.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: SB CA-99 is creeping slowly at CA-32. NB traffic is flowing normally.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: NB traffic is very heavy or stopped at CA-149.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: CA-99 appears to be flowing locally in the area of Skyway. SB traffic is slowed or stopped at Neal Rd. The backup is estimated at 2.4 km (1.5 mi). There is traffic control at Neal Rd. South of Neal Rd AVL indicates that traffic may be moving at normal speeds.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: CHP shuts down NB CA-99 at Neal Rd. This is likely in order to speed up the flow of the traffic backed up on Neal Rd onto CA-99 SB to direct evacuees away from the fire and congestion in Chico. CA-99 SB south of Neal Rd is flowing. NB CA-99 is stopped and backed up toward Durham-Pentz Rd.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: NB CA-99 is stopped south of Neal Rd, backed up in both lanes to at least Durham-Pentz Rd. First responders are driving up the shoulder.

title: CA Highway 99 traffic progression summary.
text: Very little NB traffic on CA-99; the ramp to CA-99 is blocked at CA-149. Traffic entering the region on CA-99 NB has been redirected SB onto CA-149.

title: Durham-Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Traffic is light.

title: Durham-Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Law enforcement responds to the intersection of Clark Rd to block any northbound traffic into Paradise to facilitate possible contraflow.

title: Durham-Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: There is heavy, gridlocked traffic between Pentz Rd and Clark Rd (one lane westbound backed up). Two-way traffic is still going on Clark Rd. There is 4-way traffic control at Clark Rd.

title: Durham-Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: WB traffic on Durham-Pentz Rd is directed SB at Clark Rd. Clark Rd SB is directed WB onto Durham-Pentz Rd.

title: Durham-Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Slow moving traffic at the Clark Rd intersection is backing up traffic on Clark Rd into Paradise, with fire impacting the line of traffic at the town limits

title: Durham-Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: AVL shows an engine traveling unrestricted between CA-99 and Butte College at Clark Rd.

title: Durham-Pentz Road traffic progression summary.
text: Durham-Pentz Rd has heavy traffic west of Wheelock Rd.
